required_task_models.label: Hospital logistics transport policy
required_task_models.physical_task: Move linens, meals, meds, or samples through clinical corridors under hospital rules

where_to_look.name: Clinical AMR OEM application pack
where_to_look.note: Aethon, Diligent, and similar ship hospital-specific behaviors — not warehouse AMR software.

where_to_look.name: Hugging Face robotics models
where_to_look.note: Public models rarely include hospital SOP. Treat as unknown unless named.

where_to_look.name: OpenVLA
where_to_look.note: 7B open VLA pretrained on Open X-Embodiment. Project page and Hugging Face checkpoints. Presence on a candidate is unknown until named.

where_to_look.name: Physical Intelligence π0.5
where_to_look.note: VLA with open-world generalization (April 2025). Not a site-qualified warehouse or hospital pack.

where_to_look.name: NVIDIA GR00T N1.5
where_to_look.note: Open foundation VLA for generalist humanoid robots (NVIDIA GEAR). Weights on Hugging Face. Presence on a candidate is unknown.

where_to_look.name: Hugging Face — OpenVLA checkpoints
where_to_look.note: Downloadable OpenVLA weights. The project page is the canonical lookup; this is the checkpoint index.

where_to_look.name: LeRobot on Hugging Face
where_to_look.note: Open robotics datasets and policies for download, fine-tune, and self-host.

where_to_look.name: Argo-Robot foundation models for manipulation
where_to_look.note: Survey of imitation-learning manipulation FMs (ACT, Octo, OpenVLA, Helix). Research map, not a storefront.

where_to_look.name: Foundation models in robotics (Robocloud)
where_to_look.note: Orientation on robotics foundation models. Not a catalog of site-qualified policies.

where_to_look.name: Papers with Code — robotics / manipulation
where_to_look.note: Academic leaderboards mapped to code and weights. Best-on-benchmark ≠ qualified on this workplace.

where_to_look.name: GitHub — foundation-model codebases
where_to_look.note: Cutting-edge weights often land here before commercial platforms. Search Awesome Foundation Models / Awesome robotics VLAs.

where_to_look.name: Robotic Data
where_to_look.note: Real-world Physical AI training data (LiDAR, human/task traces). A dataset is not a site-qualified warehouse or hospital policy. Do not invent a dataset price.

where_to_look.name: World Labs — real-to-sim-to-real (SceniX)
where_to_look.note: Train and evaluate robot policies in reconstructed scenes, then transfer back to the physical cell. Simulation success is not workplace qualification.

where_to_look.name: Mercor
where_to_look.note: People who can train, fine-tune, or host a robot policy. This is who builds the task model — not SIGNAL buyers and not a price list.

qualify_filters.name: Is it a robot policy (VLA / OEM pack), not a chat LLM?
qualify_filters.label: Is it a robot policy (VLA / OEM pack), not a chat LLM?
qualify_filters.note: OpenVLA, π0.5, Octo, LeRobot, ACT, GR00T N1.5, or an OEM application pack. GPT/Claude/Gemini/Llama text APIs do not pick cases or run hospital linens.

qualify_filters.name: Does the license allow commercial placement?
qualify_filters.label: Does the license allow commercial placement?
qualify_filters.note: Research-only and non-commercial CC licenses cannot put a robot into paid work. Check the model card before a distributor quotes a job.

qualify_filters.name: Can it run on this robot, on-prem, or only in the cloud?
qualify_filters.label: Can it run on this robot, on-prem, or only in the cloud?
qualify_filters.note: On-robot / edge work prefers small or quantized policies (often under ~8B parameters, or an OEM stack). Cloud VLMs are not the cell policy. Physical AI also pays simulation + always-on inference, not one pretrain run.

qualify_filters.name: Does context match the job (site map, video, long SOP)?
qualify_filters.label: Does context match the job (site map, video, long SOP)?
qualify_filters.note: Huge context windows matter for long video or documents. A pick cell still needs the motor policy, not a 1M-token chat window.

qualify_filters.name: Has it been qualified on this workplace?
qualify_filters.label: Has it been qualified on this workplace?
qualify_filters.note: A downloaded checkpoint is not a site-qualified warehouse or hospital policy until that site says so.

pricing_lookups.name: BenchLM LLM pricing
pricing_lookups.note: Pay-per-token / image API list prices. Useful for managed VLMs. Not a price for an OEM warehouse pack or a trained cell policy.

pricing_lookups.name: Axe Compute — physical AI compute stack
pricing_lookups.note: Why robot policies cost more than LLMs: simulation, synthetic data, VLA training, and continuous on-robot inference. Quote GPU hours here — do not invent a dollar figure.

pricing_lookups.name: Vertex AI Model Garden
pricing_lookups.note: Google Gemini plus curated open models, billed per token/image. Not a robot cell license.

pricing_lookups.name: Amazon Bedrock
pricing_lookups.note: Unified API pricing for Claude, Llama, Titan, and others. Filter by use case; still not a warehouse pick policy.

pricing_lookups.note: OpenAI frontier models plus enterprise open-source. Pay-per-token. Does not qualify a hospital AMR.

layer.label: Task library / skill pack
layer.note: OEM application store: warehouse pick, hospital linen, floor scrub, kitchen dish. Specific libraries for specific tasks. Usually licensed, not trained from scratch by the distributor.

time_band.label: 4–12 weeks
time_band.meaning: Custom cell, fixture, clinical SOP, or kitchen menu. Integrator SOW, not a download.

you_provide.label: Site map / layout
you_provide.examples: CAD, BIM, fleet map, aisle widths, keep-out zones

you_provide.label: Work objects
you_provide.examples: SKU list, tote/case dimensions, payload, fixture drawings, menu/dish mix

you_provide.label: Demonstration traces
you_provide.examples: Teleop or human videos of the successful task; hours of episodes, not a brochure

you_provide.label: Failure cases
you_provide.examples: Drops, collisions, occlusions, night-shift lighting, wet floors

you_provide.label: SOP and safety envelope
you_provide.examples: Who shares the aisle, infection-control rules, e-stop, payload limits

field_feedback.note: In-field traces usually improve the OEM's library, not the customer's invoice. A price cut happens only if the contract says so (data-for-license, reduced support, or a written rebate). Do not promise a discount because the robot learned on site.
